items.title: Jang interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2013
items.q: I mean I guess Jerry Lee Lewis, I don’t know if you call it dancing but there’s a movement.

ctx.x: You mean dancing and singing. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -10-

I mean that’s like me dancing while I’m playing the piano. I mean I guess Jerry Lee Lewis, I don’t know if you call it dancing but there’s a movement. But I don’t see very many people doing that. And I suppose you could.

I think it’s curious, those controversial performances, the “Star Spangled Banner” and these sports teams or whatever, they hire these people and then they’re so surprised and sometimes angry when the person sings like they do. Like you were expecting Marvin Gaye to sing the national anthem like an opera singer or like someone with great respect. And he sings it like he wants to and everybody gets bent out of shape. And it’s just curious that, well why are you hiring these people then, if you don’t want them to…
